title: INT8 weight-only: fidelity simulator and golden-seed harness for GPTQ/AWQ validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a deterministic validation harness and synthetic fidelity simulator to evaluate INT8 weight-only quantization (GPTQ and AWQ variants) across our model catalog. The goal is to detect subtle accuracy regressions introduced by quant profiles during CI and canary stages before they reach customers. This ticket delivers: 1) a workload generator (golden-seed) that replays realistic prompt mixes with controlled perturbations, 2) a fidelity simulator that measures layerwise activation drift and model-output divergence metrics, and 3) CI jobs and dashboards that gate merges based on numeric thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Golden-seed harness can re-run 10 canonical prompt suites reproducibly with fixed RNG seed
Fidelity simulator produces layerwise activation KL and logits KL for each model and profile
CI job quant-fidelity/gate runs in < 45 minutes for small-medium models and fails if embedding cosine delta > 0.015 or avg-logit-KL > 0.04
Dashboards show historical drift and per-profile baselines for at least 20 recent builds
Canary runbook for rollout/rollback documented and linked to console rollout policy
steps: Design synthetic prompt taxonomy: chat probes, instruction completions, embedding anchors, code generation snippets
Implement golden-seed runner that replays prompts with deterministic tokenization and RNG
Instrument model runtime to capture per-layer activations (sampled) and final logits for comparison
Implement fidelity metrics: per-layer activation KL, avg-logit-KL, embedding cosine delta, top-k-token-shift
Create small/medium/large model buckets and profile sweep configs for GPTQ/AWQ
Add CI job quant-fidelity/gate with time and resource limits and artifact upload
Build Grafana dashboards and restore points for baseline profiles
Write automated canary/rollback playbook and failure classification guidance
runbook: If quant-fidelity/gate fails: triage logs, collect artifacts, run local golden-seed with match-back seed
If embedding_cosine_delta > threshold: disable new profile and route to fallback fp32 model; open hotfix branch
If avg_logit_KL marginally above threshold: run debug sweep for per-layer contribution and try alternative GPTQ/AWQ params
For canary-stage failures: pause rollout, revert to previous profile, notify SRE and PM, start postmortem within 48h
updates: 2025-01-22 - Ticket opened by Aisha Patel with initial scope and high-level acceptance criteria.
2025-01-29 - Decided to support both GPTQ and AWQ parameter sets; added per-profile baselines. PM (Sofia Ramirez) approved scope reduction to focus on small/medium models first.

2025-02-05 - Implemented golden-seed runner prototype (branch feat/golden-seed). Deterministic replay validated on 3 prompt suites. Observed non-determinism in tokenizers for some edge-case unicode; added normalization step.

2025-02-12 - Fidelity simulator MVP completed: captures sampled layer activations and computes KL metrics. Observed baseline avg-logit-KL variance; introduced 7-day rolling baseline to reduce false positives.

2025-02-18 - CI job quant-fidelity/gate wired into PR pipeline as optional. Runtime team (owner: Priya Nair) suggested sampling activations only for first N tokens to reduce memory footprint — accepted as default.
2025-02-24 - UX review with Console team: added links to fail artifacts and quick diff UI. Requested clearer messaging for rollback steps in console rollout modal.

2025-02-28 - Rebased CI jobs to use dedicated small-GPU runners. Gate currently set to warning on PRs; plan to flip to hard-fail after two successful overnight runs. Assigned follow-up ENG-96200 to harden metric thresholds based on more baselines.
